correctness.rationale: Stationarity of Lx, Ly, Lz, L(x^3/3), and L(yz) yields E[x^2]=2c^2 and E[z^2]=E[y^2]. Zero derivative energy is rigidly supported on the two equilibria. For nonconstant cycles, Wirtinger gives P>=2π; equality forces a first harmonic, whose substitution forces zero amplitude, hence P>2π. Exact algebraic replay returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Periodic and connecting orbits are central in the Michelson literature. A parameter-independent strict lower bound on every nonconstant period, tied to exact stationary derivative-energy and RMS-amplitude laws, is a natural global constraint on those recurrent objects rather than a routine parameter computation.
